findings.title: Website name bypasses the untrusted-website filter
findings.body: `website` is explicitly filtered by `untrusted_attributes` for TL0 users viewed by anonymous users, but the newly serialized `website_name` has no `include_website_name?` guard and is not included in that filter. Its value is derived from the same website URL, so anonymous responses still reveal the website host and, for matching domains, its path even when the website is supposed to be hidden.

findings.title: Sibling-domain matching mistakes shared public suffixes for the same domain
findings.body: This comparison treats any two hosts with the same number of labels and the same labels after the first as belonging to the same domain. For example, with the instance at `forum.example.co.uk` and a user's website at `other.co.uk`, both hosts have three labels and the compared suffixes are both `co.uk`; the serializer incorrectly appends the website path. This produces the complete-path display for unrelated domains, contrary to the same-domain behavior this change is intended to provide.
